verses.original: לְֽמִסְפָּרָ֡ם וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל׀ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָאָב֣וֹת וְשָׂרֵ֣י הָֽאֲלָפִ֣ים׀ וְהַמֵּא֡וֹת וְשֹׁטְרֵיהֶם֩ הַמְשָׁרְתִ֨ים אֶת־ הַמֶּ֜לֶךְ לְכֹ֣ל׀ דְּבַ֣ר הַֽמַּחְלְק֗וֹת הַבָּאָ֤ה וְהַיֹּצֵאת֙ חֹ֣דֶשׁ בְּחֹ֔דֶשׁ לְכֹ֖ל חָדְשֵׁ֣י הַשָּׁנָ֑ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס הָֽאַחַ֔ת הַֽמַּחֲלֹ֙קֶת֙
verses.transliteration: lə·mis·pā·rām ū·ḇə·nê yiś·rā·’êl rā·šê hā·’ā·ḇō·wṯ wə·śā·rê hā·’ă·lā·p̄îm wə·ham·mê·’ō·wṯ wə·šō·ṭə·rê·hem ham·šā·rə·ṯîm ’eṯ- ham·me·leḵ lə·ḵōl də·ḇar ham·maḥ·lə·qō·wṯ hab·bā·’āh wə·hay·yō·ṣêṯ ḥō·ḏeš bə·ḥō·ḏeš lə·ḵōl ḥā·ḏə·šê haš·šā·nāh ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ hā·’a·ḥaṯ ham·ma·ḥă·lō·qeṯ
verses.literal: This is the list vvv of the Israelites the heads of families the commanders of thousands and of hundreds and their officers who served - the king in every matter concerning the divisions on rotating military duty . . . each month . . . throughout . . . the year There were 24,000 men . . . . . . in each division

verses.original: יָֽשָׁבְעָ֖ם בֶּן־ זַבְדִּיאֵ֑ל עַ֞ל הָרִֽאשׁוֹנָה֙ הַמַּחֲלֹ֤קֶת הָרִאשׁ֔וֹן לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ וְעַל֙ מַֽחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: yā·šā·ḇə·‘ām ben- zaḇ·dî·’êl ‘al hā·ri·šō·w·nāh ham·ma·ḥă·lō·qeṯ hā·ri·šō·wn la·ḥō·ḏeš ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: Jashobeam son of Zabdiel was in charge of the first division [which was assigned] the first month [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in his division

verses.original: מִן־ בְּנֵי־ פֶ֗רֶץ הָרֹ֛אשׁ לְכָל־ הַצְּבָא֖וֹת שָׂרֵ֥י הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃ לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ
verses.transliteration: min- bə·nê- p̄e·reṣ hā·rōš lə·ḵāl haṣ·ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ śā·rê hā·ri·šō·wn la·ḥō·ḏeš
verses.literal: - He was a descendant of Perez and chief of all the army commanders for the first month

verses.original: דּוֹדַ֤י הָאֲחוֹחִי֙ וְעַ֞ל מַחֲלֹ֣קֶת׀ הַשֵּׁנִ֗י הַחֹ֣דֶשׁ וּמִקְל֖וֹת הַנָּגִ֑יד עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ וּמַ֣חֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: dō·w·ḏay hā·’ă·ḥō·w·ḥî wə·‘al ma·ḥă·lō·qeṯ haš·šê·nî ha·ḥō·ḏeš ū·miq·lō·wṯ han·nā·ḡîḏ ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw ū·ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: Dodai the Ahohite was in charge of the division for the second month and Mikloth was the leader [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in . . . his division

verses.original: הַשְּׁלִישִׁי֙ הַצָּבָ֤א שַׂ֣ר רֹ֑אשׁ הַשְּׁלִישִׁ֔י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ בְּנָיָ֧הוּ בֶן־ יְהוֹיָדָ֛ע הַכֹּהֵ֖ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·lî·šî haṣ·ṣā·ḇā śar rōš haš·šə·lî·šî la·ḥō·ḏeš bə·nā·yā·hū ḇen- yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ hak·kō·hên ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: The third army commander as chief for the third month was Benaiah son of Jehoiada the priest [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in his division

verses.original: ה֧וּא בְנָיָ֛הוּ גִּבּ֥וֹר הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֖ים וְעַל־ הַשְּׁלֹשִׁ֑ים בְּנֽוֹ׃ס עַמִּיזָבָ֖ד וּמַ֣חֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: hū ḇə·nā·yā·hū gib·bō·wr haš·šə·lō·šîm wə·‘al- haš·šə·lō·šîm bə·nōw ‘am·mî·zā·ḇāḏ ū·ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: This Benaiah was mighty among the Thirty and was over the Thirty and his son Ammizabad was in charge of his division

verses.original: הָֽרְבִיעִ֞י הָרְבִיעִ֗י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ יוֹאָ֔ב אֲחִ֣י עֲשָׂה־ אֵל֙ בְנ֖וֹ וּזְבַדְיָ֥ה אַחֲרָ֑יו עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: hā·rə·ḇî·‘î hā·rə·ḇî·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš yō·w·’āḇ ’ă·ḥî ‘ă·śāh- ’êl ḇə·nōw ū·zə·ḇaḏ·yāh ’a·ḥă·rāw ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: The fourth for the fourth month was Joab’s brother vvv Asahel and his son Zebadiah was commander after him [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in his division

verses.original: הַחַמִישִׁי֙ הַחֲמִישִׁ֔י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשַּׂ֖ר שַׁמְה֣וּת הַיִּזְרָ֑ח עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: ha·ḥa·mî·šî ha·ḥă·mî·šî la·ḥō·ḏeš haś·śar šam·hūṯ hay·yiz·rāḥ ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: The fifth for the fifth month was the commander Shamhuth the Izrahite [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in his division

verses.original: הַשִּׁשִּׁי֙ הַשִּׁשִּׁ֔י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ עִירָ֥א בֶן־ עִקֵּ֖שׁ הַתְּקוֹעִ֑י עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: haš·šiš·šî haš·šiš·šî la·ḥō·ḏeš ‘î·rā ḇen- ‘iq·qêš hat·tə·qō·w·‘î ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: The sixth for the sixth month was Ira son of Ikkesh the Tekoite [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in his division

verses.original: הַשְּׁבִיעִי֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ חֶ֥לֶץ הַפְּלוֹנִ֖י מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרָ֑יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·ḇî·‘î haš·šə·ḇî·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš ḥe·leṣ hap·pə·lō·w·nî min- bə·nê ’ep̄·rā·yim ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: The seventh for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite vvv vvv an Ephraimite [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in his division

verses.original: הַשְּׁמִינִי֙ הַשְּׁמִינִ֔י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ סִבְּכַ֥י הַחֻשָׁתִ֖י לַזַּרְחִ֑י עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·mî·nî haš·šə·mî·nî la·ḥō·ḏeš sib·bə·ḵay ha·ḥu·šā·ṯî laz·zar·ḥî ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: The eighth for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite a Zerahite [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in his division

verses.original: הַתְּשִׁיעִי֙ הַתְּשִׁיעִ֔י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ אֲבִיעֶ֥זֶר הָעַנְּתֹתִ֖י לַבֶּנְיְמִינִי עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: hat·tə·šî·‘î hat·tə·šî·‘î la·ḥō·ḏeš ’ă·ḇî·‘e·zer hā·‘an·nə·ṯō·ṯî lab·bɛn·yə·mī·nī ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: The ninth for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite a Benjamite [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in his division

verses.original: הָעֲשִׂירִי֙ הָעֲשִׂירִ֔י לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ מַהְרַ֥י הַנְּטֽוֹפָתִ֖י לַזַּרְחִ֑י עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל֙ מַֽחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: hā·‘ă·śî·rî hā·‘ă·śî·rî la·ḥō·ḏeš mah·ray han·nə·ṭō·w·p̄ā·ṯî laz·zar·ḥî ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: The tenth for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite a Zerahite [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in his division

verses.original: עַשְׁתֵּֽי־ עָשָׂר֙ לְעַשְׁתֵּ֣י־ עָשָׂ֣ר הַחֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּנָיָ֥ה הַפִּרְעָתוֹנִ֖י מִן־ בְּנֵ֣י אֶפְרָ֑יִם עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃ס וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: ‘aš·tê- ‘ā·śār lə·‘aš·tê- ‘ā·śār ha·ḥō·ḏeš bə·nā·yāh hap·pir·‘ā·ṯō·w·nî min- bə·nê ’ep̄·rā·yim ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: The eleventh . . . for the eleventh . . . month was Benaiah the Pirathonite vvv vvv an Ephraimite [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in his division

verses.original: הַשְּׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ לִשְׁנֵ֣ים עָשָׂ֣ר הַחֹ֔דֶשׁ חֶלְדַּ֥י הַנְּטוֹפָתִ֖י לְעָתְנִיאֵ֑ל עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְאַרְבָּעָ֖ה אָֽלֶף׃פ וְעַל֙ מַחֲלֻקְתּ֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: haš·šə·nêm ‘ā·śār liš·nêm ‘ā·śār ha·ḥō·ḏeš ḥel·day han·nə·ṭō·w·p̄ā·ṯî lə·‘ā·ṯə·nî·’êl ‘eś·rîm wə·’ar·bā·‘āh ’ā·lep̄ wə·‘al ma·ḥă·luq·tōw
verses.literal: The twelfth . . . for the twelfth . . . month was Heldai the Netophathite [from the family] of Othniel [There were] 24,000 . . . . . . [men] in his division

verses.original: וְעַל֙ נָגִ֔יד שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לָרֽאוּבֵנִ֣י אֱלִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־ זִכְרִ֑יס לַשִּׁ֨מְעוֹנִ֔י שְׁפַטְיָ֖הוּ בֶּֽן־ מַעֲכָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al nā·ḡîḏ šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl lā·r·’ū·ḇê·nî ’ĕ·lî·‘e·zer ben- ziḵ·rīs laš·šim·‘ō·w·nî šə·p̄aṭ·yā·hū ben- ma·‘ă·ḵāh
verses.literal: These officers were in charge of . . . the tribes of Israel Over the Reubenites [was] Eliezer son of Zichri over the Simeonites [was] Shephatiah son of Maacah

verses.original: לְלֵוִ֛י חֲשַׁבְיָ֥ה בֶן־ קְמוּאֵ֖ל לְאַהֲרֹ֥ן צָדֽוֹק׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·lê·wî ḥă·šaḇ·yāh ḇen- qə·mū·’êl lə·’a·hă·rōn ṣā·ḏō·wq
verses.literal: over Levi [was] Hashabiah son of Kemuel over Aaron [was] Zadok

verses.original: לִֽיהוּדָ֕ה אֱלִיה֖וּ דָוִ֑יד מֵאֲחֵ֣י לְיִ֨שָׂשכָ֔ר עָמְרִ֖י בֶּן־ מִיכָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: lî·hū·ḏāh ’ĕ·lî·hū ḏā·wîḏ mê·’ă·ḥê lə·yi·śā·š·ḵār ‘ā·mə·rî ben- mî·ḵā·’êl
verses.literal: over Judah [was] Elihu one of David’s brothers over Issachar [was] Omri son of Michael

verses.original: לִזְבוּלֻ֕ן יִֽשְׁמַֽעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ עֹבַדְיָ֑הוּ לְנַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י יְרִימ֖וֹת בֶּן־ עַזְרִיאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: liz·ḇū·lun yiš·ma‘·yā·hū ben- ‘ō·ḇaḏ·yā·hū lə·nap̄·tā·lî yə·rî·mō·wṯ ben- ‘az·rî·’êl
verses.literal: over Zebulun [was] Ishmaiah son of Obadiah over Naphtali [was] Jerimoth son of Azriel

verses.original: לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם הוֹשֵׁ֖עַ בֶּן־ עֲזַזְיָ֑הוּ לַחֲצִי֙ שֵׁ֣בֶט מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה יוֹאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ פְּדָיָֽהוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: liḇ·nê ’ep̄·ra·yim hō·wō·šê·a‘ ben- ‘ă·zaz·yā·hū la·ḥă·ṣî šê·ḇeṭ mə·naš·šeh yō·w·’êl ben- pə·ḏā·yā·hū
verses.literal: over the Ephraimites . . . [was] Hoshea son of Azaziah over one of the half-tribes . . . of Manasseh [was] Joel son of Pedaiah

verses.original: לַחֲצִ֤י הַֽמְנַשֶּׁה֙ גִּלְעָ֔דָה יִדּ֖וֹ בֶּן־ זְכַרְיָ֑הוּס לְבִנְיָמִ֔ן יַעֲשִׂיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ אַבְנֵֽר׃ס
verses.transliteration: la·ḥă·ṣî ham·naš·šeh gil·‘ā·ḏāh yid·dōw ben- zə·ḵar·yå̄·hūs lə·ḇin·yā·min ya·‘ă·śî·’êl ben- ’aḇ·nêr
verses.literal: over [the] half-tribe of Manasseh in Gilead [was] Iddo son of Zechariah over Benjamin [was] Jaasiel son of Abner

verses.original: לְדָ֕ן עֲזַרְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ יְרֹחָ֑ם אֵ֕לֶּה שָׂרֵ֖י שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: lə·ḏān ‘ă·zar·’êl ben- yə·rō·ḥām ’êl·leh śā·rê šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: [and] over Dan [was] Azarel son of Jeroham These [were] the leaders of the tribes of Israel

verses.original: דָוִיד֙ וְלֹא־ נָשָׂ֤א מִסְפָּרָ֔ם לְמִבֶּ֛ן שָׁנָ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים וּלְמָ֑טָּה כִּ֚י יְהוָ֔ה אָמַ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְהַרְבּ֥וֹת אֶת־ כְּכוֹכְבֵ֥י הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: ḏā·wîḏ wə·lō- nā·śā mis·pā·rām lə·mib·ben šā·nāh ‘eś·rîm ū·lə·māṭ·ṭāh kî Yah·weh ’ā·mar yiś·rā·’êl lə·har·bō·wṯ ’eṯ- kə·ḵō·wḵ·ḇê haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: David did not count . . . the men aged twenty or under because the LORD had said that He would make Israel as numerous - as the stars of the sky

verses.original: יוֹאָ֨ב בֶּן־ צְרוּיָ֜ה הֵחֵ֤ל לִמְנוֹת֙ וְלֹ֣א כִלָּ֔ה בָזֹ֛את קֶ֖צֶף וַיְהִ֥י עַל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הַמִּסְפָּ֔ר וְלֹ֤א עָלָה֙ בְּמִסְפַּ֥ר דִּבְרֵֽי־ הַיָּמִ֖ים לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד׃ס
verses.transliteration: yō·w·’āḇ ben- ṣə·rū·yāh hê·ḥêl lim·nō·wṯ wə·lō ḵil·lāh ḇā·zōṯ qe·ṣep̄ way·hî ‘al- yiś·rā·’êl ham·mis·pār wə·lō ‘ā·lāh bə·mis·par diḇ·rê- hay·yā·mîm lam·me·leḵ dā·wîḏ
verses.literal: Joab son of Zeruiah began to count [the men] but did not finish For because of this [census] wrath came upon Israel and the number was not entered . . . in the Book of the Chronicles of King David

verses.original: עַזְמָ֖וֶת בֶּן־ עֲדִיאֵ֑לס וְעַל֙ הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ אֹצְר֣וֹת יְהוֹנָתָ֖ן בֶּן־ עֻזִּיָּֽהוּ׃ס וְעַ֣ל הָֽאֹצָר֡וֹת בַּשָּׂדֶ֞ה בֶּעָרִ֤ים וּבַכְּפָרִים֙ וּבַמִּגְדָּל֔וֹת
verses.transliteration: ‘az·mā·weṯ ben- ʿă·ḏī·ʾē·ls wə·‘al ham·me·leḵ ’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ yə·hō·w·nā·ṯān ben- ‘uz·zî·yā·hū wə·‘al hā·’ō·ṣā·rō·wṯ baś·śā·ḏeh be·‘ā·rîm ū·ḇak·kə·p̄ā·rîm ū·ḇam·miḡ·dā·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: Azmaveth son of Adiel was in charge of the royal storehouses Jonathan son of Uzziah was in charge of the storehouses in the country in the cities in the villages and in the fortresses

verses.original: עֶזְרִ֖י בֶּן־ כְּלֽוּב׃ וְעַ֗ל עֹשֵׂי֙ מְלֶ֣אכֶת הַשָּׂדֶ֔ה לַעֲבֹדַ֖ת הָאֲדָמָ֑ה
verses.transliteration: ‘ez·rî ben- kə·lūḇ wə·‘al ‘ō·śê mə·le·ḵeṯ haś·śā·ḏeh la·‘ă·ḇō·ḏaṯ hā·’ă·ḏā·māh
verses.literal: Ezri son of Chelub was in charge of the workers . . . in the fields who tilled the soil

verses.original: שִׁמְעִ֖י הָרָֽמָתִ֑י וְעַל־ הַ֨כְּרָמִ֔ים זַבְדִּ֖י הַשִּׁפְמִֽי׃ס וְעַ֤ל שֶׁבַּכְּרָמִים֙ הַיַּ֔יִן לְאֹצְר֣וֹת
verses.transliteration: šim·‘î hā·rā·mā·ṯî wə·‘al- hak·kə·rā·mîm zaḇ·dî haš·šip̄·mî wə·‘al šeb·bak·kə·rā·mîm hay·ya·yin lə·’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ
verses.literal: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce of the vineyards for the wine vats

verses.original: חָנָ֖ן הַגְּדֵרִ֑יס וְעַל־ הַזֵּיתִ֤ים וְהַשִּׁקְמִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר בַּשְּׁפֵלָ֔ה בַּ֥עַל יוֹעָֽשׁ׃ס וְעַל־ אֹצְר֥וֹת הַשֶּׁ֖מֶן
verses.transliteration: ḥā·nān hag·gə·ḏē·rīs wə·‘al- haz·zê·ṯîm wə·haš·šiq·mîm ’ă·šer baš·šə·p̄ê·lāh ba·‘al yō·w·‘āš wə·‘al- ’ō·ṣə·rō·wṯ haš·še·men
verses.literal: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive and sycamore trees - in the foothills Joash was in charge of the stores of olive oil

verses.original: שִׁטְרַי הַשָּׁרוֹנִ֑י וְעַל־ הַבָּקָר֙ הָרֹעִ֣ים בַּשָּׁר֔וֹן שָׁפָ֖ט בֶּן־ עַדְלָֽי׃ס וְעַל־ הַבָּקָר֙ בָּֽעֲמָקִ֔ים
verses.transliteration: šiṭ·ray haš·šā·rō·w·nî wə·‘al- hab·bā·qār hā·rō·‘îm baš·šā·rō·wn šā·p̄āṭ ben- ‘aḏ·lāy wə·‘al- hab·bā·qār bā·‘ă·mā·qîm
verses.literal: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds grazing in Sharon Shaphat son of Adlai was in charge of the herds in the valleys

verses.original: אוֹבִ֖יל הַיִּשְׁמְעֵלִ֑י וְעַל־ הַ֨גְּמַלִּ֔ים יֶחְדְּיָ֖הוּ הַמֵּרֹנֹתִֽי׃ס וְעַל־ הָ֣אֲתֹנ֔וֹת
verses.transliteration: ’ō·w·ḇîl hay·yiš·mə·‘ê·lî wə·‘al- hag·gə·mal·lîm yeḥ·də·yā·hū ham·mê·rō·nō·ṯî wə·‘al- hā·’ă·ṯō·nō·wṯ
verses.literal: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys

verses.original: יָזִ֣יז הַֽהַגְרִ֑י וְעַל־ הַצֹּ֖אן כָּל־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ שָׂרֵ֣י לַמֶּ֥לֶךְ דָּוִֽיד׃ הָרְכ֔וּשׁ אֲשֶׁ֖ר
verses.transliteration: yā·zîz ha·haḡ·rî wə·‘al- haṣ·ṣōn kāl- ’êl·leh śā·rê lam·me·leḵ dā·wîḏ hā·rə·ḵūš ’ă·šer
verses.literal: Jaziz the Hagrite was in charge of the flocks All these officials [were] in charge of King David’s property -

verses.original: דָּוִיד֙ דּוֹד־ וִֽיהוֹנָתָ֤ן יוֹעֵ֔ץ ה֑וּא אִישׁ־ מֵבִ֥ין וְסוֹפֵ֖ר וִֽיחִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־ חַכְמוֹנִ֖י עִם־ בְּנֵ֥י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: dā·wîḏ dō·wḏ- wî·hō·w·nā·ṯān yō·w·‘êṣ hū ’îš- mê·ḇîn wə·sō·w·p̄êr wî·ḥî·’êl ben- ḥaḵ·mō·w·nî ‘im- bə·nê ham·me·leḵ
verses.literal: David’s uncle Jonathan was a counselor he was a man of insight and a scribe Jehiel son of Hachmoni attended to the sons of the king

verses.original: וַאֲחִיתֹ֖פֶל לַמֶּ֑לֶךְס יוֹעֵ֣ץ וְחוּשַׁ֥י הָאַרְכִּ֖י הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ רֵ֥עַ
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·ḥî·ṯō·p̄el lam·mɛ·lɛḵs yō·w·‘êṣ wə·ḥū·šay hā·’ar·kî ham·me·leḵ rê·a‘
verses.literal: Ahithophel was the king’s counselor Hushai the Archite was the king’s friend

verses.original: אֲחִיתֹ֗פֶל וְאַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹיָדָ֤ע בֶּן־ בְּנָיָ֙הוּ֙ וְאֶבְיָתָ֔ר יוֹאָֽב׃פ וְשַׂר־ לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ צָבָ֥א
verses.transliteration: ’ă·ḥî·ṯō·p̄el wə·’a·ḥă·rê yə·hō·w·yā·ḏā‘ ben- bə·nā·yā·hū wə·’eḇ·yā·ṯār yō·w·’āḇ wə·śar- lam·me·leḵ ṣā·ḇā
verses.literal: Ahithophel was succeeded by Jehoiada son of Benaiah then by Abiathar Joab was the commander of the king’s army
